name: alchemy-new-publish-action
description: GitHub Action that publishes a ready archive to the alchemy.new package registry.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --banner:js="/* alchemy-new-publish-action */" && node --import tsx scripts/normalize-bundle.mts
scripts.check: nub run typecheck && nub run lint && nub run format && nub run test && nub run build
scripts.check-dist: nub run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
